interfaceChangelog.change: added nine clips (Wave, HandholdIdle_L/R, HandholdWalk_L/R, ScooterIdle/Ride, SkateboardIdle/Ride) and the Home / Street / Reception kit (15 ids)
interfaceChangelog.impact: additive: no existing id, pivot, socket, clip, bound or appearance rule changed. Wave is the first clip with loop = false, so a caller must read CLIP_INFO[name].loop instead of assuming LoopRepeat.

interfaceChangelog.change: Batch 1 completed with the CarryIdle, CarryWalk and SeatedIdle clips; studio.chair seat height fitted to SeatedIdle (0.42 -> 0.36); added the Batch 2 activity props (6 ids)
interfaceChangelog.impact: additive for asset ids; the three new clips join the existing two on the same rig and bindings; the chair seat height is a visual dimension the caller can still override

interfaceChangelog.change: added the room kit (7 ids), studio kit (4 ids) and two optional atmosphere ids; added LIGHTING_REFERENCE as exported data
interfaceChangelog.impact: additive only: no existing id, pivot, socket, clip or appearance rule changed

interfaceChangelog.change: socket_hat moved to [0, 0.33, 0] and socket_glasses to [0, 0.235, 0.172] in J_head space, because the head is now a cuboid
interfaceChangelog.impact: avatar-internal; hats and glasses are owned by the avatar, so no integration code changes
additive; never placed in the game

interfaceChangelog.change: avatar and plank geometry rebuilt as chamfered cuboids; plank body and shoe materials now use vertexColors
interfaceChangelog.impact: visual only: pivots, units, facing, bounds envelope, clips, bindings, asset ids and appearance semantics unchanged

assets.units: 1 world unit = 50 logical px (s = 0.02). X = (logical_x - 500) * s, Z = (logical_y - 240) * s, Y = visual height.
assets.axes: +Y up; +Z toward the viewer / larger logical y; an avatar faces +Z at rotation.y = 0; character-left = +X.
assets.pivot: root on the floor between the feet; never animated

Walk.assumption: root translated at nominalSpeed along +Z (the facing direction) at timeScale 1

clips.name: Idle
clips.notes: Grounded breathing/weight loop. Feet solved to fixed floor positions; no world displacement.

clips.name: Walk
clips.timeScaleRule: timeScale = displayedSpeed / nominalSpeed (1.0 at the unchanged 108 px/s host speed)
clips.notes: In place. During stance the planted ankle moves backwards relative to the root at exactly nominalSpeed, so the foot is stationary on the floor when the host moves the avatar at 108 px/s.

clips.name: CarryIdle
clips.notes: Idle with both arms forward at socket_held. The hands sit at the carried object; nothing is welded to the avatar.

clips.name: CarryWalk
clips.timeScaleRule: timeScale = displayedSpeed / nominalSpeed; carrying never changes the host speed
clips.notes: Walk legs with the carry arms held steady. Same travel per cycle as Walk: carrying is not slower.

clips.name: SeatedIdle
clips.placement: Place the avatar root at the seat centre on the floor. The clip lifts the hips onto the cushion and folds the legs; the hips never move horizontally.
clips.notes: Feet rest flat on the floor in front of the chair; the back does not pass through the chair back.

clips.name: Wave
clips.placement: Play once on top of / after Idle. The first and last frames are exactly the Idle frame at t = 0, so it blends back without a pop.
clips.notes: Greeting only. The name label the 2D renderer draws while waving stays in the host HUD; the clip carries no text.

clips.name: HandholdIdle_L
clips.notes: Standing, the character-left hand held out to the join point half way to the partner. Pair the leader _L with the follower _R.

clips.name: HandholdWalk_L
clips.timeScaleRule: timeScale = displayedSpeed / nominalSpeed; holding hands never changes the host speed
clips.notes: Walk legs; the held hand stays on the join point while the free arm swings. Same travel per cycle as Walk.

clips.name: HandholdWalk_R
clips.timeScaleRule: timeScale = displayedSpeed / nominalSpeed; holding hands never changes the host speed

clips.name: ScooterIdle
clips.contact: both feet on the deck; the object rolls, so no foot carries the motion
clips.notes: The coasting pose (simulation.mjs pose "coasting"). Both hands on the handlebar, knees softly flexed.

clips.name: ScooterRide
clips.timeScaleRule: timeScale = displayedSpeed / nominalSpeed (1.0 at the unchanged 165 px/s ride speed)
clips.contact: both feet on the deck; the object rolls, so no foot carries the motion and the clip claims no planted stride
clips.notes: Moving pose (simulation.mjs pose "riding"): forward lean, a sway and a knee cycle. Following the 2D renderer, riding changes the arms and the lean, not the stride.

clips.name: SkateboardIdle
clips.contact: both feet on the deck; the object rolls, so no foot carries the motion
clips.notes: The coasting pose. Arms out a little for balance, no handlebar.

clips.name: SkateboardRide
clips.timeScaleRule: timeScale = displayedSpeed / nominalSpeed (1.0 at the unchanged 165 px/s ride speed)
clips.contact: both feet on the deck; the object rolls, so no foot carries the motion and the clip claims no planted stride
clips.notes: Moving pose: lean, sway and a knee cycle, arms counterbalancing.

sockets.name: socket_held
sockets.purpose: provisional held-object anchor in front of the torso (0.75 above the floor at rest); Batch 1 carry clips refine the grip

sockets.name: socket_hat
sockets.purpose: hat seat on the block head (top of the head cuboid is 0.38); straw hat and cap are children

sockets.name: socket_glasses
sockets.purpose: glasses bridge point on the front face of the block head

prop.bridge-plank.note: plank centre at socket_held; the hands meet its top face

prop.activity-cube.note: cube centre just below socket_held, clear of the chin, as the 2D sprite draws it

default.note: attach the object socket_grip to socket_held

scooter.note: One foot forward on the deck, one behind it; the pushing foot leaves the deck and touches the floor.

skateboard.note: Both feet on the deck while coasting; the back foot reaches the floor to push.

holdProfile.note: The _L clips reach with the character-left hand to a join point half way to the partner (x = +0.32, y = 0.70, in the frontal plane); _R mirrors them. The pair relation itself stays with the host.

homeStreetKit.note: Sizes come from the baseline logical rectangles; heights and depths that the 2D projection folds into one rectangle are authored and declared per placement.

activityIdentities.note: cube words, objectives and pair indexes are deliberately absent from the pack

notModelledByDesign: the presentation deck, slide text, activity wording, cube pairings and portrait photographs (they stay with the host)
the lettering painted on the reception welcome board and the BEL frontage (both ship as blank panels)
Home has no plant solid in scenes.mjs, so the pack places no plant there even though the painting shows one

colorPipeline.note: Source hexes are sRGB; THREE.Color converts them to the working space. Neutral tone mapping keeps the warm key from clipping the cream walls while leaving the activity colours where the source put them. Audit this before adding more light.

lighting.note: data only: Gemini owns the live renderer and applies these numbers

assembly.note: reference placement only; Gemini owns real placement, collision and state

gateD_gameIntegration.reason: Owned by Gemini: application adapter, four-window Chrome tests and state mapping are outside this pack.
